import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_88/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, list them here
    ]

    # Target schema columns and types
    target_columns = ['Airline', 'Date_of_Journey', 'Source', 'Destination', 'Route',
                      'Dep_Time', 'Arrival_Time', 'Duration', 'Total_Stops',
                      'Additional_Info', 'Price']

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load source CSV
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Ensure all target columns exist in source
        missing_cols = set(target_columns) - set(df.columns)
        if missing_cols:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in source file {file_path}: {missing_cols}")

        # Select and reorder columns to match target schema
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Convert Price to integer (some CSVs might have it as float or string)
        df['Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Price'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

        # Strip whitespace from string columns to clean data
        for col in target_columns:
            if col != 'Price':
                df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip()

        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes into one target dataframe
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Export the combined dataframe to the target CSV path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_88/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
